import sys

def main():
    # Read the number of sensors
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    # Read all remaining content and split into individual values
    remaining = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    
    # Parse all floating point numbers from the remaining input
    if remaining:
        readings = list(map(float, remaining.split()))
    else:
        readings = []
    
    # Ensure we have exactly n readings, pad with zeros if needed
    while len(readings) < n:
        readings.append(0.0)
    
    # Take only the first n readings
    readings = readings[:n]
    
    # Print the output in the required format
    print("Sensor Readings:")
    for reading in readings:
        print("{0:.2f}".format(reading))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
